items.title: Hypolite Charles Interview, 1963-04-13
items.q: Harry Parker, Charlie Parker, Billy Phillips, Gyp the Blood, they had a terrible killer in there

ctx.x: But that reminds me, we forgot about accordion. But anyway, he was playing right across the street I think from where the murder was, you know. Harry Parker, Charlie Parker, Billy Phillips, Gyp the Blood, they had a terrible killer in there and they closed down that town. So you know, that slowed things down. Well how many places did they close down when they closed down that had actual
bands? Because I think it was around 17, 1916 and 17 they closed this place.
